scientific_integrity: The parameter-wide theorem is proved by exact rational identities, with reproducible symbolic and finite full-matrix checks. General earlier methods are credited; no general novelty of inverse-trace formulation or resolvent claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two different vertices, identical positive finite feedback gain, unit undirected edges, clique core with one private leaf per core, additive diagonal pinning and inverse-trace criterion; no variable gains, edge-weight design, other graph classes, or independent audit. Originality limited to inspected sources and targeted searches.
title: Exact two-leader gain transition on complete-graph coronas
